Spraying, decorating and wallpaper, one decorator.

uPVC spraying is one of the most requested jobs: a cost-effective alternative to replacing windows, doors or a conservatory. The inside of the house gets the same careful preparation.

uPVC spraying

Windows, doors and conservatories

High-bond coatings applied on site, for a smooth factory-quality finish. Sprayed over uPVC, powder-coated and composite.

  • uPVC window frames
  • Front, back and patio doors
  • Conservatories and orangeries
  • Garage doors
  • Fascias, soffits and gutters
  • Kitchen cupboards and furniture
Interior decorating

Rooms, wallpaper and woodwork

Free advice on finishes, colours, budget and wallcoverings on the first visit. Floors and furniture protected, surrounds masked off.

  • Walls, ceilings and woodwork
  • Wallpaper hanging and feature walls
  • Staircases, bannisters and radiators
  • On-site spraying of kitchens, wardrobes and doors
  • Colour consultation
Exterior painting

Protect and refresh the outside

Weatherproof coatings that protect, restore and lift the look of a property.

  • Masonry and rendered walls
  • Windows and doors
  • Exterior woodwork
  • Fences, gates and sheds
  • Fascias and soffits

Wallpaper is his speciality.

Browse a vast library of wallpapers to find your design, or supply your own and Paul will hang it. A feature wall can change a whole room.

Preparation is most of the job.

  1. A free visit

    Paul talks through the project and gives free guidance on finishes, colours and budget-friendly options.

  2. Clean and prepare

    All surfaces are thoroughly cleaned and prepared, with repairs made before any coating goes on.

  3. Mask and protect

    Floors and furniture are covered and surrounds masked, so there is no paint on sockets, units or carpets.

  4. Spray or paint

    The finish goes on, and your home is left clean, tidy and beautifully finished.
